intro: Camping 101: Alchemy introduces budding alchemists in Ironforge to practical fieldcraft under the guidance of Vosur Brakthel. By learning to construct a Mana Well for their wilderness camps, alchemists can provide vital rejuvenation to spellcasters and healers on the road.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that you've taken up Alchemy, I can also teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp once you've learned a bit. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Mana Well. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
